name: The Story of My Life
source:
The Story of My Life is a kinetic visual novel that explores the life of Noah. From his tween years into young adulthood, dealing with love, loss, and his mental health.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/917610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《我一生的故事》是一部动态视觉小说，探索诺亚的一生。从他的青少年时期到成年初期，他一直在处理爱情、失落和心理健康。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/917610/]Steam[/url]]
